args.title: Bouldering with Ren
args.body: Start with the longer forearm warmup, then easy movement and progressive checks in the repaired right shoe. Build total loading gradually before harder small-edge attempts; space hard efforts and avoid starting at max intensity. Stop and step back if pain exceeds 2/10, symptoms last 30 minutes, or symptoms appear the next morning.
